pages.text: $(italic)A living canvas of ink and will. Weak early, devastating late. The ultimate hyperscaler.$()$(br2)$(bold)Origin Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Paper-Thin$() — $(warn)-20% max HP$(). Your body is made of ink and parchment.$(br2)$(bold)Ink-Stained Appetite$() — $(warn)Food provides 50% less nourishment.$(br2)$(bold)Flammable Canvas$() — $(warn)Fire burns hotter against your ink-stained body.$()

pages.title: Hyperscaling
pages.text: $(bold)Boss Kill Scaling$() — Each boss kill grants stacking bonuses to damage, damage reduction, and armor toughness (max 200 stacks).$(br2)$(bold)Blessing of Penthesilea$() — $(item)At 200 boss kills: defenses double and Haste is granted permanently.$(br2)$(italic)The Witch of Ink is intentionally punishing for the first 50+ hours. The payoff is becoming one of the strongest origins in the game.$()
